Hello there,

While reviewing A-Plus Air Conditioning & Home Solutions' public pages, I noticed you describe commercial HVAC work as "The Austin Commercial AC Repair Company" and publish a page on "When to Schedule AC Replacement." This is not a claim about how your team works today - we have no visibility into that.

Based only on public information, a short deterministic simulation was prepared using synthetic example inputs, not real customer data. It is a simulation - not a system deployed, connected, official, or operated by the business. It routes every case to a human review step before any action. Would you be open to comparing it with your actual intake process?

The simulation: https://ac-request-demo.preview.emergentagent.com/

Andrew
